summary_brief: 今日 (2026-01-21) 发现 8 个 Commit 信号，9 个 Release 信号。

engineering_signals.title: Agent SDK 优先架构
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code Action 移除 CLI 路径，转而完全依赖 Agent SDK，标志着 AI 编程工具正从简单的命令行包装器向结构化的 SDK 抽象层演进，提升了可维护性和扩展性。

engineering_signals.title: 模型能力检测与回退
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Fabric 和 GPTme 新增对模型特定能力（如推理、图像生成）的检测与兼容性警告。这反映了 AI 应用正从“假设模型全能”转向“根据模型能力动态适配功能”的鲁棒性设计趋势。

engineering_signals.title: 多模态与上下文压缩
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Gemini CLI 实现了增强的锚定迭代上下文压缩，而 Cline 优化了 Jupyter Notebook 支持。这显示 AI 工具正在积极解决长上下文和高维数据（如 Notebook）带来的性能与 Token 消耗挑战。

engineering_signals.title: 沙箱与安全隔离
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 和 OpenCode 均在加强沙箱机制，特别是在 Windows 路径解析、权限控制及配置文件加载限制方面。这反映了业界对 AI Agent 自主操作系统的安全性担忧正在推动更严格的隔离标准。

engineering_signals.title: 异步工作流与并发
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: DeepAgents 和 DeerFlow 正在将检索器和核心工作流重构为异步/等待模式。这是为了应对 Agent 系统中日益增长的 I/O 密集型操作（如工具调用、API 请求），以提升响应速度和吞吐量。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 与插件生态
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenCode 和 Gemini CLI 在 MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务器的 OAuth 回调、指令修复和工具输入保留方面进行了大量修复。MCP 正成为连接 AI Agent 与外部数据/服务的标准协议，其稳定性至关重要。

engineering_signals.title: 自动化代码审查
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Auto-Claude 引入了带有验证管道和上下文增强的 PR 审查功能。这展示了 AI Agent 正从单纯的“写代码”向更复杂的“审查与协作”工作流扩展，旨在提升整个软件生命周期的效率。

research_signals.title: Agent 评估与遥测
research_signals.why_it_matters: Gemini CLI 引入了针对通用 Agent 的初始评估，并增加了遥测功能以跟踪计划模式的采用情况。这表明 Agent 系统的开发重点正从单纯的功能实现转向科学的效果评估与数据驱动优化。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added history-based autocomplete in bash mode (`!`) - type a partial command and press Tab to complete from your bash command history
- Added search to installed plugins list - type to filter by name or description
- Added support for pinning plugins to specific git commit SHAs, allowing marketplace entries to install exact versions
- Fixed a regression where the context window blocking limit was calculated too aggressively, blocking users at ~65% context usage instead of the intended ~98%
- Fixed memory issues that could cause crashes when running parallel subagents
- Fixed memory leak in long-running sessions where stream resources were not cleaned up after shell commands completed
- Fixed `@` symbol incorrectly triggering file autocomplete suggestions in bash mode
- Fixed `@`-mention menu folder click behavior to navigate into directories instead of selecting them
- Fixed `/feedback` command generating invalid GitHub issue URLs when description is very long
- Fixed `/context` command to show the same token count and percentage as the status line in verbose mode
- Fixed an issue where `/config`, `/context`, `/model`, and `/todos` command overlays could close unexpectedly
- Fixed slash command autocomplete selecting wrong command when typing similar commands (e.g., `/context` vs `/compact`)
- Fixed inconsistent back navigation in plugin marketplace when only one marketplace is configured
- Fixed iTerm2 progress bar not clearing properly on exit, preventing lingering indicators and bell sounds
- Improved backspace to delete pasted text as a single token instead of one character at a time
- [VSCode] Added `/usage` command to display current plan usage

key_changes: 新增 bash 模式历史命令自动补全功能（Tab 键触发）
修复上下文窗口阻塞限制计算错误（从 65% 恢复至预期的 98%）
修复并行子代理崩溃和长时间会话内存泄漏问题
插件市场增强：支持通过 SHA 固定版本、新增搜索过滤功能
多项用户体验改进：命令覆盖层稳定性、斜杠命令补全准确性、粘贴文本删除等
ai_summary.summary_cn: Claude Code v2.1.14 版本主要带来了 bash 历史命令自动补全等新功能，并重点修复了上下文窗口阻塞限制计算错误、并行子代理崩溃及内存泄漏等严重影响使用的问题。同时优化了插件市场体验（支持 SHA 固定版本和搜索）以及多项命令相关的交互细节，整体提升了稳定性和可用性。

- Included priority assessment capability that assigns P0-P4 priority levels based on urgency signals in descriptions
